About HydroFlow

Revolutionizing hydroponic farming with intelligent monitoring and control systems for sustainable agriculture.

1

Connect Your System

Link your Blynk IoT device to HydroFlow. Takes just 2 minutes with your authentication token and server address.

2

Select Your Plants

Choose from our database of hydroponic-friendly plants or search by name to find ideal growing conditions.

3

Monitor Real-Time

Watch live sensor readings for pH, TDS, temperature, water levels, and pump status. Get instant alerts for anomalies.

4

Analyze & Optimize

View historical data in weekly and monthly charts. Identify trends and adjust conditions for maximum plant health.

5

Harvest & Repeat

Achieve higher yields with data-driven decisions. Keep refining your technique with every growing cycle.
